chunks: As for whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah have mercy on them both—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār and Aḥmad ibn Idrīs together, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī.

key_terms.الْأَشْعَرِيِّ: Al-Ashʿarī; the nisbah identifying the narrator in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicates joint transmission from the two named shaykhs.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through a stated sanad/isnad.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; part of the author’s transmission chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad route through which the author transmits reports from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission pathway for hadith in the book and preserving the scholarly chain of authority.
